help: Commands: /help, /new, /cancel, /sentence <text>. Other text starts a conversation.
new: A new conversation will start with your next message.
failed: The request failed. It will not be run again automatically.
interrupted: The request was interrupted. Check the result on your desktop before submitting it again.
title: Channels
deletePrompt: Delete this connection and revoke its bindings? Saved learning results are retained.
testSuccess: Telegram is reachable and the Bot Token is valid.

errors.COMMUNICATION_FAILED: The channel operation failed. Try again.
errors.TELEGRAM_DUPLICATE_BOT: This Bot already has a connection.
errors.TELEGRAM_BOT_MISMATCH: The Token belongs to another Bot. Create a new connection for it.
errors.TELEGRAM_UNAUTHORIZED: The Bot Token is invalid or has been revoked.
errors.TELEGRAM_WEBHOOK_CONFLICT: This Bot has a webhook. Remove it in your existing integration before starting.
errors.TELEGRAM_POLL_CONFLICT: Another program is polling this Bot. Stop it before starting here.
errors.TELEGRAM_CURSOR_INVALID: The saved Telegram cursor is invalid. The connection was stopped.
errors.TELEGRAM_RESPONSE_TOO_LARGE: The Telegram response exceeded the size limit.
errors.TELEGRAM_RATE_LIMITED: Telegram requested a pause before retrying.
errors.TELEGRAM_NOT_SENT: The Telegram request was not sent.
errors.TELEGRAM_ADMISSION_FAILED: An update could not be saved. Its receipt was not acknowledged.
errors.CONNECTION_STOP_FAILED: The connection could not be stopped. Try again.
errors.CHALLENGE_INVALID: The code has expired or is invalid. Generate a new code and send the binding command again.
errors.QQ_DUPLICATE_APP: This QQ AppID already has a connection.
errors.QQ_UNAUTHORIZED: The QQ AppID or AppSecret is invalid or has been revoked.
errors.QQ_GATEWAY_UNAVAILABLE: QQ did not allow the WebSocket connection. Check event delivery mode and direct message permissions.
errors.QQ_RATE_LIMITED: QQ is limiting requests. Wait before retrying.
errors.QQ_ADMISSION_FAILED: The QQ event could not be saved. The channel will retry the connection.

bindingReminder: Your channel has been added. Start the channel, copy the binding command from its card and send it in a private chat with this Bot. Return here to check the account and confirm binding. Messages will not receive replies until binding is complete.
bindingCodeEmpty: Generate a code to bind an account
bindingInstructions: Start the channel, send /bind <code> in a private chat with this Bot, then confirm the account here. Binding allows conversation and sentence saving.
bindingCodePrivacy: Codes last 5 minutes and are shown only on this page. Generating a new code invalidates the previous one.
bindingCodeExpired: The binding code has expired. Generate a new one.
bindingCopyFailed: Could not copy. Select the code and send /bind <code> manually.
bindingCandidate: Account awaiting confirmation: {{name}} (Telegram user ID: {{userId}}). Confirm only if this is your account.
qqTruncated: Reply shortened. See the full answer on desktop.
qqSetup: Enable WebSocket and direct messages for the bot in the QQ Open Platform. Keep Lingo Mate running and start the channel after opening the app. Lingo Mate sends up to four replies within five minutes of the original message.
qqCredentialMissing: Add an AppSecret before starting the channel.
qqInvalidInput: Enter a valid AppID and AppSecret.
qqTestSuccess: Credentials accepted and the QQ gateway is reachable. Start the channel to subscribe to events.
qqBindingInstructions: Start the channel, then send /bind <code> in a direct message to the bot. Confirm the QQ account here.
qqBindingCandidate: Confirm that this is your QQ account {{name}} (OpenID {{userId}}).
qqUnbindPrompt: Remove learning access for QQ account {{userId}}?
